name: JRDB Edge TRUE_FORWARD Settlement via Issue

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  issues: write

env:
  REQUEST_PREFIX: '[JRDB_EDGE_FORWARD_SETTLE]'

jobs:
  settle:
    if: >-
      github.event.issue.user.login == 'yukki0113' &&
      startsWith(github.event.issue.title, '[JRDB_EDGE_FORWARD_SETTLE]')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout latest main
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Parse and validate request
        id: request
        env:
          ISSUE_BODY: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
          ISSUE_TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os, re
          from pathlib import Path

          prefix='[JRDB_EDGE_FORWARD_SETTLE]'
          title=os.environ['ISSUE_TITLE']
          request_id=title[len(prefix):].strip()
          if not request_id or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,96}', request_id):
              raise SystemExit('request_id in title must match [A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,96}')
          req=json.loads((os.environ.get('ISSUE_BODY') or '').strip())
          required={'date','freeze_run_id','freeze_artifact_name','freeze_manifest_sha256','matches_sha256'}
          missing=sorted(required-set(req))
          if missing:
              raise SystemExit(f'missing required fields: {missing}')
          day=str(req['date']).strip()
          if not re.fullmatch(r'20\d{6}',day):
              raise SystemExit('date must be YYYYMMDD')
          freeze_run=req['freeze_run_id']
          if not isinstance(freeze_run,int) or freeze_run<=0:
              raise SystemExit('freeze_run_id must be a positive integer')
          freeze_artifact=str(req['freeze_artifact_name']).strip()
          if not freeze_artifact:
              raise SystemExit('freeze_artifact_name must be non-empty')
          sha_re=re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{64}')
          freeze_manifest_sha=str(req['freeze_manifest_sha256']).strip().lower()
          matches_sha=str(req['matches_sha256']).strip().lower()
          if not sha_re.fullmatch(freeze_manifest_sha) or not sha_re.fullmatch(matches_sha):
              raise SystemExit('freeze_manifest_sha256 and matches_sha256 must be lowercase SHA-256 hex')
          expected_sed=req.get('expected_sed_sha256')
          if expected_sed is not None:
              expected_sed=str(expected_sed).strip().lower()
              if not sha_re.fullmatch(expected_sed):
                  raise SystemExit('expected_sed_sha256 must be lowercase SHA-256 hex')
          prior=req.get('previous_ledger')
          normalized_prior=None
          if prior is not None:
              if not isinstance(prior,dict):
                  raise SystemExit('previous_ledger must be an object')
              prior_required={'run_id','artifact_name','ledger_sha256'}
              prior_missing=sorted(prior_required-set(prior))
              if prior_missing:
                  raise SystemExit(f'previous_ledger missing fields: {prior_missing}')
              prior_run=prior['run_id']
              prior_artifact=str(prior['artifact_name']).strip()
              prior_sha=str(prior['ledger_sha256']).strip().lower()
              if not isinstance(prior_run,int) or prior_run<=0 or not prior_artifact or not sha_re.fullmatch(prior_sha):
                  raise SystemExit('previous_ledger fields are invalid')
              normalized_prior={'run_id':prior_run,'artifact_name':prior_artifact,'ledger_sha256':prior_sha}
          normalized={
              'request_id':request_id,
              'date':day,
              'race_date':f'{day[:4]}-{day[4:6]}-{day[6:]}',
              'freeze_run_id':freeze_run,
              'freeze_artifact_name':freeze_artifact,
              'freeze_manifest_sha256':freeze_manifest_sha,
              'matches_sha256':matches_sha,
              'expected_sed_sha256':expected_sed,
              'previous_ledger':normalized_prior,
              'evaluation_mode':'TRUE_FORWARD',
          }
          Path('/tmp/request.json').write_text(
              json.dumps(normalized,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n',encoding='utf-8'
          )
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'],'a',encoding='utf-8') as fh:
              fh.write(f'request_id={request_id}\n')
              fh.write(f'date={day}\n')
          PY

      - name: Edge forward regression tests
        run: |
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -q pytest
          python -m pytest -q \
            horse-racing/jrdb/tests/test_jrdb_edge_forward_operations.py \
            horse-racing/jrdb/tests/test_build_jrdb_edge_forward_ledger.py

      - name: Download and verify frozen upstream artifact
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p /tmp/freeze
          python - <<'PY' > /tmp/freeze_env.sh
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          req=json.loads(Path('/tmp/request.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          print(f"FREEZE_RUN_ID={req['freeze_run_id']}")
          print(f"FREEZE_ARTIFACT_NAME={req['freeze_artifact_name']}")
          print(f"FREEZE_MANIFEST_SHA={req['freeze_manifest_sha256']}")
          print(f"MATCHES_SHA={req['matches_sha256']}")
          PY
          source /tmp/freeze_env.sh
          gh run download "$FREEZE_RUN_ID" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --name "$FREEZE_ARTIFACT_NAME" --dir /tmp/freeze
          mapfile -t manifests < <(find /tmp/freeze -type f -name manifest.json -print)
          mapfile -t matches < <(find /tmp/freeze -type f -name edge_matches.jsonl -not -path '*/inputs/*' -print)
          if [ "${#manifests[@]}" -ne 1 ] || [ "${#matches[@]}" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "freeze artifact must contain exactly one root manifest and matches file" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          cp "${manifests[0]}" /tmp/freeze_manifest.json
          cp "${matches[0]}" /tmp/edge_matches.jsonl
          echo "$FREEZE_MANIFEST_SHA  /tmp/freeze_manifest.json" | sha256sum -c -
          echo "$MATCHES_SHA  /tmp/edge_matches.jsonl" | sha256sum -c -
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          req=json.loads(Path('/tmp/request.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          manifest=json.loads(Path('/tmp/freeze_manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          if manifest.get('status')!='PASS' or manifest.get('evaluation_mode')!='TRUE_FORWARD':
              raise SystemExit('upstream freeze manifest is not successful TRUE_FORWARD')
          if manifest.get('pre_race_guard')!='PASS':
              raise SystemExit('upstream freeze pre_race_guard is not PASS')
          if manifest.get('race_date')!=req['race_date']:
              raise SystemExit(f"upstream freeze race_date mismatch: {manifest.get('race_date')} != {req['race_date']}")
          PY

      - name: Fetch post-race SED
        env:
          JRDB_USER: ${{ secrets.JRDB_USER }}
          JRDB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.JRDB_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, subprocess
          from pathlib import Path
          req=json.loads(Path('/tmp/request.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          out=Path('/tmp/raw')
          out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
          subprocess.run([
              'python','horse-racing/jrdb/src/fetch_jrdb_history.py',
              '--date',req['date'],'--kinds','SED','--output-dir',str(out)
          ],check=True)
          sed=out/'SED'/f"SED{req['date'][2:]}.zip"
          if not sed.is_file():
              raise SystemExit(f'SED missing: {sed}')
          digest=hashlib.sha256(sed.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          if req.get('expected_sed_sha256') and digest!=req['expected_sed_sha256']:
              raise SystemExit(f"SED SHA mismatch: expected={req['expected_sed_sha256']} actual={digest}")
          Path('/tmp/sed_sha256.txt').write_text(digest+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
          PY

      - name: Restore optional previous TRUE_FORWARD ledger
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p /tmp/edge_forward_settlement
          python - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, shutil, subprocess
          from pathlib import Path
          req=json.loads(Path('/tmp/request.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          target=Path('/tmp/edge_forward_settlement/jrdb_edge_forward_ledger.sqlite')
          prior=req.get('previous_ledger')
          if prior is None:
              raise SystemExit(0)
          root=Path('/tmp/prior_ledger')
          root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
          subprocess.run([
              'gh','run','download',str(prior['run_id']),
              '--repo',str(__import__('os').environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY']),
              '--name',prior['artifact_name'],'--dir',str(root)
          ],check=True)
          candidates=list(root.rglob('jrdb_edge_forward_ledger.sqlite'))
          if len(candidates)!=1:
              raise SystemExit(f'expected exactly one prior ledger, found {len(candidates)}')
          digest=hashlib.sha256(candidates[0].read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          if digest!=prior['ledger_sha256']:
              raise SystemExit(f"prior ledger SHA mismatch: expected={prior['ledger_sha256']} actual={digest}")
          shutil.copy2(candidates[0],target)
          PY

      - name: Settle frozen TRUE_FORWARD matches and append ledger
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, subprocess
          from pathlib import Path
          req=json.loads(Path('/tmp/request.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          cmd=[
              'python','horse-racing/jrdb/src/run_jrdb_edge_forward_settlement.py',
              '--matches-jsonl','/tmp/edge_matches.jsonl',
              '--freeze-manifest','/tmp/freeze_manifest.json',
              '--sed',f"/tmp/raw/SED/SED{req['date'][2:]}.zip",
              '--ledger','/tmp/edge_forward_settlement/jrdb_edge_forward_ledger.sqlite',
              '--output-dir','/tmp/edge_forward_settlement',
              '--expected-freeze-manifest-sha256',req['freeze_manifest_sha256'],
              '--expected-matches-sha256',req['matches_sha256'],
          ]
          if req.get('expected_sed_sha256'):
              cmd.extend(['--expected-sed-sha256',req['expected_sed_sha256']])
          if req.get('previous_ledger'):
              cmd.extend(['--expected-ledger-sha256',req['previous_ledger']['ledger_sha256']])
          subprocess.run(cmd,check=True)
          PY

      - name: Build compact settlement result
        env:
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          REQUEST_ID: ${{ steps.request.outputs.request_id }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          root=Path('/tmp/edge_forward_settlement')
          req=json.loads(Path('/tmp/request.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          manifest=json.loads((root/'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          provenance=json.loads((root/'provenance.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          evaluation=json.loads((root/'forward_evaluation.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          ledger_result=json.loads((root/'ledger_result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          result={
              'status':'success',
              'run_id':int(os.environ['RUN_ID']),
              'head_sha':os.environ['HEAD_SHA'],
              'artifact_name':f"jrdb-edge-forward-settlement-{os.environ['REQUEST_ID']}-{os.environ['RUN_ID']}",
              'date':req['date'],
              'race_date':manifest['race_date'],
              'evaluation_mode':'TRUE_FORWARD',
              'freeze_run_id':req['freeze_run_id'],
              'freeze_artifact_name':req['freeze_artifact_name'],
              'freeze_manifest_sha256':req['freeze_manifest_sha256'],
              'matches_sha256':req['matches_sha256'],
              'sed_sha256':provenance['sed_sha256'],
              'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/'manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              'ledger_sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/'jrdb_edge_forward_ledger.sqlite').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              'ledger_import':ledger_result.get('import'),
              'cumulative_summary':ledger_result.get('summary',{}).get('overall'),
              'evaluation_overall':evaluation.get('overall'),
              'runner_audit':evaluation.get('runner_audit'),
              'previous_ledger':req.get('previous_ledger'),
          }
          (root/'result.json').write_text(
              json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n',encoding='utf-8'
          )
          PY

      - name: Upload settlement artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: jrdb-edge-forward-settlement-${{ steps.request.outputs.request_id }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: /tmp/edge_forward_settlement/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
          compression-level: 6

      - name: Comment success and close Issue
        if: success()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os, subprocess
          from pathlib import Path
          result=json.loads(Path('/tmp/edge_forward_settlement/result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          body='JRDB_EDGE_FORWARD_SETTLE_RESULT\n```json\n'+json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n```\n'
          subprocess.run(['gh','issue','comment',os.environ['ISSUE_NUMBER'],'--repo',os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY'],'--body',body],check=True)
          subprocess.run(['gh','issue','close',os.environ['ISSUE_NUMBER'],'--repo',os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY'],'--reason','completed'],check=True)
          PY

      - name: Comment failure
        if: failure()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os, subprocess
          result={
              'status':'failure',
              'run_id':int(os.environ['RUN_ID']),
              'failure_class':'IMPLEMENTATION_ERROR',
              'error_code':'EDGE_FORWARD_SETTLEMENT_FAILED',
              'retryable':False,
              'message':'Inspect the failed Actions step and rebuild the request from latest main; do not blindly rerun.',
          }
          body='JRDB_EDGE_FORWARD_SETTLE_FAILURE\n```json\n'+json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n```\n'
          subprocess.run(['gh','issue','comment',os.environ['ISSUE_NUMBER'],'--repo',os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY'],'--body',body],check=True)
          PY
